units.source_text: 高段棋手下一盘棋，一般需要十个小时的光景。

en.t: For a high-ranking go player to play one game usually takes about ten hours.

units.source_text: 唯独这盘棋，据说规定可用时四十小时，等于延长四倍。

en.t: Only for this game, it is said, the rules allowed forty hours of playing time, which amounted to a fourfold extension.

units.source_text: 最后黑方实际用时三十四小时十九分，耗时相当多。

en.t: In the end, Black actually used thirty-four hours and nineteen minutes, a very considerable amount of time.

units.source_text: 自从围棋规定时间以来，这一盘是空前绝后的。

en.t: Since time limits were introduced in go, this game has been without precedent and without equal.
